parameters.series: optional native IDs CSV; default all six
parameters.local_only: true default; false current temporary gap fill only; no persistence
parameters.query_mode: current default; history inferred with as_of
parameters.as_of: aware ISO8601 inclusive cutoff; required for history
parameters.as_of_basis: available default / observed; all derived operands use the same cutoff

response_fields.rows: week_ending descending, then requested series order

filters.reference_week: Saturday YYYY-MM-DD coverage filter; actual or prior roles; never reference_month
filters.source_version: exact YYYY-MM-DD source version, date precision

release_records.row_association: series/week scope_only; explicit roles/source_version; scheduled_publication_at only for confirmed actual with embargo_header; prior roles never imply first release time

source_contract.temporal_contract: DOL-ETA reference weeks independent; realtime dates not publication instants

source_contract.pagination_contract: limit100000; offset0; count must equal rows; no hidden pagination
